card.name: Quantity words in group-size phrases
card.fires_on: Small words like "a", "one", "the" or a number that start a phrase about how many or how much of a group, e.g. "a group of", "a majority of", "a minimal change". Seen in study results and general prose.

modes.label: "a" before group or amount
modes.description: The article "a" opens a phrase about a group size or degree, such as majority, group or median.
modes.example: during which<< a>> majority of patients received concomitant NSA

modes.label: Numbers and counts
modes.description: A number word or digit that gives a count or fraction of people or outcomes.
modes.example: There were <<2>> birth defects and 12 normal infants

card.plain: It marks a small word that introduces a count or portion of a group, such as "a majority of" or "one type of".
